extensionName.description: Name of the extension. Personally I suggest to keep it in English for easier search on AMO.

extensionDescription.message: Allows to rotate, flip and zoom images directly on any website from context menu.

enableTransformationAnimation.description: Checkbox in options to enable animations.

rotateClockwise.description: Context menu entry for rotating the image by given number of degrees to the left.

rotateCounterclockwise.description: Context menu entry for rotating the image by given number of degrees to the left.

zoomIn.description: Context menu entry for zooming the image to given scale more than 100%.

zoomOut.description: Context menu entry for zooming the image to given scale more than 100%.

flipHorizontally.description: Context menu for flipping the image horizontally (left to right).

flipVertically.description: Context menu for flipping the image vertically (upside down).

resetAll.description: Context menu entry to reset all image transformations.
